articles.title: CC Overspray Halo
articles.summary: Fine horizontal banding in M and R, faint Cc variation; reads as tight horizontal clearcoat streaks, not a broad halo ring. A fine, even orange-peel grain; at distance it dulls the mirror slightly and gives a soft textured gloss.
articles.what: Overspray halo — spray gun edge mist, ring of thin/rough clearcoat at spray boundary, B=Clearcoat Up close: A regular honeycomb of soft round dimples about 12 px apart, evenly spaced across the whole tile like a dense pebbled or orange-peel texture. Dimples light up in the highlight band, dark rings between them, no larger shapes or halos visible. From a distance: A fine, even orange-peel grain; at distance it dulls the mirror slightly and gives a soft textured gloss. It changes the shine only, never the colour. Channels it touches: the channels set by its defaults. Group: Clearcoat & Coating (Legacy collection tab of the spec overlay picker). Texture detail: micro.
how: Click a zone card and expand SPEC OVERLAYS.
Click + ADD SPEC OVERLAY, open the Legacy collection tab and the group "Clearcoat & Coating", or search for "CC Overspray Halo".
Click it, then click Add this overlay in the Inspect surface window.
Set Strength (default 50%) and tick the Metallic, Roughness and Clearcoat boxes you want.
Use Size and Rotation to make the texture finer, then render.
tips: Hood, roof and doors: even coverage
Everywhere you want the clearcoat to look sprayed
Numbers remain readable; the dimples are small and even.
Clear but gentle: a soft pebbled orange-peel look in the lit stripe
Pairs well with: gloss, satin, matte.
pitfalls: Not a visible halo ring or spray edge: at this scale it is plain even dimples
Not frost or sandblast: the dimples are regular and rounded
Avoid: do not promise a broad halo ring, scale unverified beyond fine.
articles.intent_note: A spec pattern changes the shine only: metal, roughness and clearcoat, never the paint colour.
articles.paint_advice: It cannot recolour anything. Metal added to a light paint looks bright; metal added to a dark paint stays dark, because metal reflection inherits the paint colour. Pair it with a paint that gives the gloss difference something to show on.

combos.why: Up to five overlays stack in order; a strong overlay can wash out the ones below it.
The blend mode decides how this overlay meets the base shine. Normal is the safe start.
Coat values 1 to 15 and roughness under 15 on non-chrome pixels are raised to safe values on export.

examples.result: The shine of the zone gets this texture while the colours stay put.

articles.title: CC Panel Fade
articles.summary: Directional clearcoat gradient across panel; one side glossy, one side dull, soft warped fade band. A fine soft checkerboard or tiled sheen at distance; the gloss varies tile to tile rather than fading smoothly as the name suggests.
articles.what: Panel fade — clearcoat thickness gradient across panel from spray angle, one side gloss one side dull, B=Clearcoat Up close: A regular grid of soft square tiles about 28 px across with narrow lighter gutters between them, like bathroom tiles or a window screen. On satin the tiles read as dull squares with glowing grid lines; on metal the tiles brighten and the lines fade to a faint seam. From a distance: A fine soft checkerboard or tiled sheen at distance; the gloss varies tile to tile rather than fading smoothly as the name suggests. It changes the shine only, never the colour. Channels it touches: the channels set by its defaults. Group: Clearcoat & Coating (Legacy collection tab of the spec overlay picker). Texture detail: micro.

articles.title: CC Panel Pool
articles.summary: Scattered soft gloss pools in low spots; blotchy Gaussian clearcoat patches, uneven wet sheen, low contrast. Reads as an almost plain sheen with slight uneven gloss; the pools show as soft, wide gloss variation on a whole panel.
articles.what: Clearcoat pooling — gravity-settled extra-clear in panel low spots, scattered Gaussian gloss pools, B=Clearcoat Up close: Nearly smooth. On satin there are faint mottled dark flecks and soft blotches; on metal the lit band carries a very fine wavy moire-like shimmer. Gloss pools are broad and gentle, far larger than this crop. From a distance: Reads as an almost plain sheen with slight uneven gloss; the pools show as soft, wide gloss variation on a whole panel. It changes the shine only, never the colour. Channels it touches: the channels set by its defaults. Group: Clearcoat & Coating (Legacy collection tab of the spec overlay picker). Texture detail: micro.

articles.title: CC Wet Zone
articles.summary: Sparse darker wet-looking clearcoat blobs; glossier patches over slightly duller base, organic uneven pooling. Reads as plain sheen with slightly uneven, wet-looking gloss; the ripples are too fine to see.
articles.what: Wet zones — unleveled clearcoat blob patches at higher gloss, organic FBM-thresholded dark areas, B=Clearcoat Up close: On satin: faint dark hairline squiggles and tiny blotches scattered thinly. On metal: concentric ripple rings and fine wavy contour lines inside the highlight, like drops hitting water. Blob patches themselves are bigger than this crop. From a distance: Reads as plain sheen with slightly uneven, wet-looking gloss; the ripples are too fine to see. It changes the shine only, never the colour. Channels it touches: the channels set by its defaults. Group: Clearcoat & Coating (Legacy collection tab of the spec overlay picker). Texture detail: micro.
